# Toolpath UI packages

> Open-source SDKs, UI primitives, logic packages and examples for building applications with the Toolpath API. Toolpath analyzes a CAD part so an application can show it, plan how to machine it, and price it.

Each package's README is its full documentation, and the npm packages ship it. The API key is a secret: call Toolpath from a server, never from the browser. The logic packages (plan, quoting, dfm, tool-support) store nothing and call nothing; the application keeps its data and makes the API calls.

## Call the API

- [@toolpath/api](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/sdk-typescript/README.md): TypeScript client for the Toolpath Engine API, and the helper that uploads a CAD file to its presigned URL
- [toolpath (Python)](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/sdk-python/README.md): the same API in Python, shipped as a wheel on GitHub releases
- [API documentation](https://developers.toolpath.com): guides, authentication and the HTTP API
- [OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/openapi/openapi.json): the API shapes the SDKs are generated from

## Show and edit a part

- [@toolpath/viewer](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/viewer/README.md): React Three Fiber viewer for analyzed parts; `/engine` loads a Toolpath report
- [@toolpath/ui](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/ui/README.md): React and Tailwind controls, the theme, and the DFM views
- [@toolpath/plan](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/plan/README.md): plan mode (setups, folders, pinned features, ignored faces), every edit as one action list, Undo/Redo, and the plan Toolpath makes from it
- [@toolpath/app-support](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/app-support/README.md): shared application logic (preferences, contexts, route helpers)

## Quote and check a part

- [@toolpath/quoting](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/quoting/README.md): the quote flow (part state, stages and moves, quote status, revisions, expiry), the quoting app's plan draft, and the rules for sending a part to Toolpath (`/pipeline`)
- [@toolpath/dfm](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/dfm/README.md): design-for-manufacturing rules and the part checker

## Cutting tools

- [@toolpath/tool-support](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/tool-support/README.md): tools, holders, collets and assemblies, with CAM exporters
- [@toolpath/tool-drawing](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/tool-drawing/README.md): a 2D drawing of a tool and its holder
- [@toolpath/tool-scraper](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/tool-scraper/README.md): reads tool geometry from vendor catalogs

## Examples and templates

- [TypeScript example](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/examples/typescript/README.md): upload a STEP file and read its analysis
- [Python example](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/examples/python/README.md): the same in Python
- [React viewer example](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/examples/react-viewer/README.md): show an analyzed part with `@toolpath/viewer`
- [Part Viewer template](https://github.com/toolpath/toolpath-template): a starting point for a customer application

## Develop an application repository

- [@toolpath/dev-config](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/packages/dev-config/README.md): one versioned development standard for TypeScript repositories: strict lint and TypeScript presets, Vitest/Playwright/Jest Expo factories, React Compiler adapters, automatic pre-commit formatting, shared CI, Engine API test fixtures, and agent instructions. A dev dependency only.

## Optional

- [Contributor guide](https://github.com/toolpath/ui-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for work on these packages, not for building an application with them
